fields.Subject: Thank you — and one small ask
fields.Body:
Hi Elena,

Thank you for having me at the Partner Retreat. The room was generous and the questions were excellent.

If the session landed, a short testimonial would mean a great deal — two or three sentences is plenty.

And you mentioned a Q2 session for the advisor network; I would love to talk about it whenever suits.

Best,
Ben

fields.Subject: Welcome aboard — a few things for the Advisor Kickoff
fields.Body:
Hi Jonah,

Delighted this is happening. Three things to get us moving:

1. The questionnaire — it takes about ten minutes and shapes the whole session.
2. Speaker assets (bio, headshots, AV rider).
3. A planning call about four weeks out.

We will take care of the rest.

Best,
The Ben Nemtin team

fields.Subject: Checking in — Regional Managers Meeting
fields.Body:
Hi Rachel,

Just a short note to check in on the Regional Managers Meeting. We are still holding the date, and I wanted to make sure you have everything you need for the board conversation.

Anything I can answer?

Best,
Ben

fields.Subject: Thanks for reaching out about the Frontline Leaders Summit
fields.Body:
Hi Nadia,

Thank you for getting in touch about the Frontline Leaders Summit. I have your details and will come back to you within one business day with availability and next steps.

Best,
The Ben Nemtin team

fields.Subject: Should we release the hold?
fields.Body:
Hi Sofia,

We have been holding the week for the Nursing Leadership Forum. Another enquiry has come in for the same dates, so before I let them go I wanted to check whether this is still live on your side.

A yes, a no, or a "not yet" are all genuinely useful — I would rather know than guess.

Best,
Ben

fields.Subject: Quick nudge — run-of-show for Chicago
fields.Body:
Hi Priya,

We are eleven days out and I do not have the run-of-show yet. It is the last piece we need to lock the AV window.

Best,
The Ben Nemtin team
